packageRules.description: Base image 'ubuntu': stay on the 24.04 LTS tag but pin it by digest, and let Renovate keep that digest current (tracks the latest 24.04 rebuild for reproducible-yet-updated builds).
GitHub Actions updates in workflow file(s) in .github/workflows/*. Pin version digests. Requires Workflows: write permission; set false if you don't want that!
Block any major version updates. Remove or empty array to allow major updates.
No minimumReleaseAge for our own images - they have their own delays.

Patch updates only, within the current major.minor (e.g. 1.36.x, not 1.37.x): kubectl-tools (Kubernetes-bound version), ORAS (minor updates may break), PowerShell (stays on its LTS line, e.g. 7.6; LTS = even minor, odd = STS - bump to the next LTS by hand). allowedVersions filters the versions BEFORE Renovate picks the update, so a newer minor never hides the patch, and the patch stays in the same group PR (unlike separateMinorPatch, which adds a 'patch-' group PR). The template uses the current version, so no editing when the minor is bumped by hand.

Base image 'ubuntu': block tag version changes so it never moves off 24.04 to a non-LTS (24.10) or the next LTS (26.04) - only digest updates are allowed. Bump the tag by hand when adopting the next LTS.

Run the checksum-refresh hook ONLY for deps that pin a matching ARG *_CHECKSUM (PowerShell, ORAS). After a version bump it refreshes the checksum so version+checksum land in the same PR (build stays offline, no live checksum fetch). Scoped here on purpose: other deps like 'ubuntu' are digest-only (no newVersion) and have no checksum handler, so running the hook for them would invoke the script with an empty version and abort the run. Self-hosted only: the command must be allowlisted via allowedCommands (RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS in .github/workflows/renovate.yml).

customManagers.description: DOCKERFILE-ARG packages: track versions pinned via 'ARG <NAME>_VERSION' with a 'renovate:' comment above them
IMAGES: update cr.vidinet.net image tags annotated with a 'renovate:' comment above the 'tag:' line
